note: Fits on profile, fails on economics. He works at Netflix in a role he expects to grow into, which reads as 'something along those lines' against a criteria list built around business owners and physicians. Health is unambiguously the neglected area rather than a crisis — sedentary role, 5,000 steps, a gym membership used inconsistently, four to five coffees, no bedtime routine — and he is not deconditioned or gym-averse. Income is an explicit miss in his own words: 'I don't think I can invest that right now' and 'It's high for like when you change it to Mexican currency.' Good-to-great is a miss too, though a narrow one: he is reaching back for a 2016 peak rather than pushing past a current good, which is nearer the rebuilder pattern than the good-to-great one. The finding worth escalating is that the stated ICP has no geographic or purchasing-power criterion at all. This prospect qualified himself out on exactly that basis — 'this is probably like a better fit for people in the UK' — while explicitly declining to ask for a discount. A single USD price is being marketed into markets where it converts very differently, and nothing upstream of the closer screens for it.
